name: Pie for Billy
summary: Auntie Bernice Stonefield's missing necklace has left Billy Maclure bargaining for a pork belly pie. The Stonefield and Maclure families have feuded for generations, and Billy will say who has the necklace only after he gets his pie.

sections.title: A Boy's Bribe
sections.body: Billy Maclure gives no apology when asked about Auntie Bernice Stonefield's missing necklace. He will not return it or say who has it until he gets a freshly baked pork belly pie. He knows Bernice is the finest cook in the valley, and he means to enjoy the bargain.

sections.title: Baking Through Bad Blood
sections.body: The Maclures and Stonefields have traded insults, brawls, and accusations across their pumpkin patches for generations. Bernice is furious at the thought of feeding the boy she believes stole her family's jewelry, yet she agrees to bake. You gather tender meat from the wild boars roaming the nearby pastures, and she sets aside her pride to get her prized necklace back.

faq.q: Why does Billy want a pie before talking?
faq.answer: Billy Maclure knows where Auntie Bernice's necklace is and uses that knowledge to bargain for food. He will not say who has it until he gets one of Bernice's pork belly pies.

faq.q: Why does Auntie Bernice agree to bake for a thief?
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice is furious at the boy she believes stole her necklace, but she sees no other way to recover it. She agrees to bake once you bring her boar meat, putting the return of her property ahead of her pride.

faq.q: Where does the meat for the pie come from?
faq.answer: The meat comes from wild boars foraging in the meadows and along the edges of the Stonefield and Maclure farms in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What is the history between the Stonefields and Maclures?
faq.answer: The Stonefield and Maclure families are neighboring farmers with a bitter rivalry that has lasted for years. They suspect each other of theft, vandalism, and bad-faith squabbling across their property lines.

faq.q: Did Billy actually steal the necklace?
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice accuses Billy directly. He avoids a straight confession, but clearly knows where the necklace ended up and uses that knowledge to bargain for food.

faq.q: What happens after Bernice gets the meat?
faq.answer: When you bring her the tender boar meat, Auntie Bernice bakes a pork belly pie for you to take to Billy. She hopes he will then reveal who has her necklace.

angles.text: Auntie Bernice says wild boar meat can be tough and bland, but proper spices and a slow simmer make it exceptional savory pie filling.
As a human, you see the stubborn, insular rivalries of Elwynn's rural homesteaders, just south of Stormwind's gates.
